extracted.intended_audience: members of the public and stakeholders who wish to submit comments on FAA petition docket FAA-2024-2527 (petitions for exemption) and parties interested in the petition summary
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for submitting public comments on an FAA petition for exemption (Docket No. FAA-2024-2527), including deadlines, required docket identification, submission methods, privacy/disclosure of comments, and how to access the docket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments deadline and docket identification requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments on this petition must identify the petition docket number and must be received on or before June 2, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From DATES: "Comments on this petition must identify the petition docket number and must be received on or before June 2, 2025." (also printed page 20338). Ensure your submission includes the docket number and is received by the closing date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods for submitting comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Send comments identified by docket number FAA-2024-2466 using any of the following methods: Federal eRulemaking Portal (https://www.regulations.gov), Mail, Hand Delivery/Courier, or Fax.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal eRulemaking Portal: go to https://www.regulations.gov and follow online instructions for sending comments electronically. Mail: Docket Operations, M-30; U.S. Department of Transportation, 1200 New Jersey Avenue SE, Room W12-140, West Building Ground Floor, Washington, DC 20590-0001. Hand Delivery/Courier: take comments to Docket Operations in Room W12-140 between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, except Federal holidays. Fax: Fax comments to Docket Operations at (202) 493-2251.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy and public posting of comments
rubrics_metrics.description: In accordance with 5 U.S.C. 553(c), DOT solicits comments from the public and posts these comments, without edit, including any personal information the commenter provides, to https://www.regulations.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments are posted without edit, including personal information. See the system of records notice (DOT/ALL-14 FDMS) and DOT privacy information at https://www.dot.gov/privacy for details about how comments and personal data will be handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to access docket background documents and submitted comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Background documents or comments received may be read at https://www.regulations.gov at any time or at Docket Operations in Room W12-140 of the West Building Ground Floor at 1200 New Jersey Avenue SE during regular business hours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the online instructions for accessing the docket on Regulations.gov or visit the Docket Operations office between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, except Federal holidays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Inspection and verifying official Federal Register edition
rubrics_metrics.description: The PDF is FR Doc. 2025-08360 as it appeared on Public Inspection on 05/12/2025; if using public inspection listings for legal research, verify contents of the documents against a final, official edition of the Federal Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice of publication to the public and judicial notice to the courts under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507. Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar for the official electronic format and verify against govinfo.gov where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document headings and drafting reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Document headings vary by document type but may contain: the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and the number of each part the document amends, proposes to amend, or is directly related to; the agency docket number / agency internal file number; the RIN which identifies each regulatory action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the Document Drafting Handbook for more details on headings and drafting conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of notice and effect on legal status
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice contains a corrected summary of a petition seeking relief from specified requirements of Federal Aviation Regulations and is published to improve the public's awareness of, and participation in, this aspect of the FAA's regulatory activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Neither publication of this notice nor the inclusion or omission of information in the summary is intended to affect the legal status of the petition or its final disposition. This notice is published pursuant to 14 CFR 11.85.
